name: find-flight
description: Google Flights search for agents — a pi extension (search_flights tool) + portable skill, powered by the fast-flights scraper.

scripts.verify: python3 -c "import json,sys; from pathlib import Path; Path('flight_runner.py')" && python3 -c "[compile(open(f, encoding='utf-8').read(), f, 'exec') for f in ['flight_runner.py', 'airports.py', 'examples/search_flights.py']]" && python3 -c "import airports; assert airports.is_known('IST') and airports.country_name('TR')=='Türkiye'" && echo "runner OK"
